profile_text.body:
Khan Academy is a nonprofit organization that operates an online education platform accessible at khanacademy.org. The company's own website returned only a client challenge response during harvesting, so direct description of its mission and offerings is limited to what the held facts record.

Khan Academy's tracked AI product is Khanmigo, categorized as an educational AI tutor. The held facts note that Khanmigo involves student interaction data, is subject to COPPA compliance considerations, and carries a noted concern around pedagogical bias. No litigation, MCP server registrations, or SEC filings are associated with the company in the held facts.
